abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Shed Skin
abilities.effect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.effect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.effect: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

abilities.name: Color Change
abilities.effect: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.effect: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.
abilities.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
abilities.flavor_text: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
abilities.flavor_text: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

abilities.name: Wind Power
abilities.effect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.effect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.flavor_text: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.
abilities.flavor_text: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

abilities.name: Supreme Overlord
abilities.effect: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.
abilities.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
abilities.flavor_text: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during rain.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.effect: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
abilities.flavor_text: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.effect: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.effect: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: Protects against critical hits.
abilities.flavor_text: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.
